template.name: AML CCI Meeting Lines
template.entry_long: close > open and close - open >= {p0} * atr(high,low,close,{p0}) and rsi(close,{p1}) <= {p1}
template.notes: A large bullish candle plus RSI(18)<=40 proxies the documented Meeting Lines and CCI<=-50 vote; RSI>=80 proxies the extreme exit. The two-candle equal-close test and body-average period 3 cannot be recovered without shifted OHLC, and no percentage protection is supplied.
